in_game_description: Following the discovery of the smallest particles in the universe, microchips have shrunk enormously. If you buy a load of microchips, consider using a hadron microscope to check they are all there before paying.
mechanics_text: Required for blueprints: 2t Intelli Jet, 5t AMR Extinctor, 5t Liberator, 10t Yin Co. Shadow Ninja, 15t 128MJ Railgun, 20t Mass Driver MD 10, 75t Khador Drive, 80t Fluxed Matter Shield.
More common in high tech level systems, especially Nivelian systems and Thynome.
